Use the project `atlas` Agent Skill and current ARC repository truth.

First select the appropriate Atlas mode: `onboard`, `adopt`, `audit`, `health`, `upgrade`, `recover`, or `next`. Inspect available durable context before asking questions. Ask only for information that cannot be resolved safely.

For new estates, use the current onboarding/profile path. For existing estates, inventory first and classify owners as KEEP / INTEGRATE / MIGRATE / RESEARCH / RETIRE; classify configured repositories as REUSE / CREATE where observable.

Never imply that ARC restores private-file contents, specialist-system records, credentials, runtime machine state or memory contents; those remain external-owner responsibilities under `contracts/safe-harbour.md`.
